Seven rooms
Deluxe Double
Standard Double

All seven rooms are doubles, and between them they sleep fourteen. Only one has air conditioning, so ask when you book if you want the one that has it.

The rooms are furnished much alike. The bed is a mint-green four-poster double with a teal velvet throw on it, and there’s a timber towel ladder and a green cabinet with a mirror.

Deluxe Double Room

1 large double bed | Sleeps 2 | 13 m², with its own bathroom, a private entrance, a terrace and a balcony.

See rooms and live dates on Booking.com
In every room
Mint-green four-poster double
Teal velvet throw
Timber towel ladder
Green cabinet with a mirror
Fan and mosquito net
Around the courtyard

Sea You is a white two-storey house. Downstairs there’s an inner courtyard, with potted plants and a cushioned bench, and the room doors that open onto it have carved fanlights over them.

From the balconies upstairs you look out over the garden to the coconut palms. There are tables and chairs out there, and the long one has a settee with green cushions.

Carved doors and a surfboard shower

One of the rooms has a carved grey double door, and the wooden chair beside it is carved too. Elsewhere, carved wooden masks hang by a doorway among the ferns.

Out in the garden there’s a shower built into a wooden surfboard, fixed to the wall under the palms. It’s for rinsing off after the sea.

Breakfast

Breakfast here is Asian, with local specialities and warm dishes, and there’s juice and fruit too.

Ashly

Your host is Ashly. He’s a Superhost on Airbnb and usually replies there within a few hours.

“Whether you’re chasing the perfect wave, soaking up the beach vibes, or just looking to unwind,” he writes, “our place is your perfect home away from home.”

We had a great stay! Ashly was incredibly friendly, welcoming, and very accomodating. The room was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location is amazing, just steps away from the sea and restaurants.
We would definitely recommend staying here!

Kenza | Airbnb | Feb 2026

We really enjoyed our stay! Great location and price! Private balcony outside of rooms. The host is extremely responsive and helpful. Let us check in sooner, was able to book an additional night, recommend where to get laundry done & sorted an airport transfer for us! Highly recommend staying here

Niamh | Airbnb | Jan 2026

I had a very pleasant stay at this place. For the paid price, the room were absolutely good value and met my expectations. Outside, there is a lovely and well-maintained patio area, which is very nice to relax in. Ashley, the owner, is truly fantastic, very kind, attentive, and always ready to help with anything you might need. He really makes you feel welcome and well taken care of.

Marina, Italy | Booking.com | Feb 2026

Amazing location in Midigama. Great place to stay, would recommend

Molly Jayne | Airbnb | Feb 2026

It was a nice place to stay. Would recommend to go there.

Raul | Airbnb | Mar 2026

Finding the house

Booking.com lists the house under Kumbalgama and Airbnb under Matara, but it’s one house, in Midigama.

Midigama railway station is 950 m away on foot and Weligama Beach is 3.4 km, both by Booking.com’s count.

151 Weliwaththa Rd, Midigama 80650, Sri Lanka

Open in Google Maps

Check-out 06:00–10:00 | Children of any age are welcome; there are no cots or extra beds. Pets on request, and charges may apply. No parties or events.

Live dates are on Booking.com, and groups can rent the whole house on Airbnb.
